seed_policy: Evaluate all three seeds separately; report individual scores, mean and sample standard deviation. Do not select a seed by score.

inference.instruction: 判断评论整体情感，仅输出0表示负面、1表示正面。
inference.truncation: Use frozen 512-character prefix; if encoded prompt exceeds2048 tokens remove comment characters from tail, preserving instruction.
inference.decoding: Decode generated continuation only, skip_special_tokens=True; retain raw decoded output before strip.

metrics.parser: Only raw_output.strip() exactly0 or1 is valid.
metrics.invalid: Count as incorrect, include in denominator and true-class FN; report invalid rate and invalid confusion column.

boundaries.model_revision: Original download revision unknown; local base files pinned by SHA256 in private manifest.

ai_assistance: Engineering transcription of already confirmed T01 and existing validation inference rules; no new design, model inference or result analysis.
